SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.name AS event_name, o.user_id IS NOT NULL AS event_operator, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM audit_logs a WHERE a.space_id = e.space_id AND a.event_id = e.id AND a.action = #{revokedAction} AND CAST(a.detail ->> 'userId' AS uuid) = #{userId} ) AS access_revoked, o.role AS event_role, CASE WHEN o.user_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE
END AS owner_authority_ended, ( SELECT p.effect FROM event_user_permissions p WHERE p.space_id = e.space_id AND p.event_id = e.id AND p.user_id = o.user_id AND p.permission = #{permission} ) AS stored_effect FROM events e LEFT JOIN event_users o ON o.space_id = e.space_id AND o.event_id = e.id AND o.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.id = #{eventId}
